name: Pinnacle Security Stab-Resistant Undershirt
description:
A tight-fitting undershirt woven with para-aramid fibers that provide certified stab and slash resistance. The fabric is layered in a crosshatch pattern that catches and distributes the force of edged weapons across a wider area. The shirt covers torso and upper arms.

Standard issue for patrol officers and private security working in Shelf districts where bladed weapons are more common than firearms. The Stab-Resistant Undershirt doesn't stop bullets and doesn't pretend to — it stops the knife you didn't see coming.
functionality: Stab and slash resistance, torso and upper arm coverage
what_it_says: You work where people carry blades and you've accepted that one of those blades is eventually aimed at you.
story_hooks: A stab-resistant undershirt shows a cut pattern that partially penetrated the para-aramid — whatever blade was used is sharper than anything the fabric was rated to stop.
